content.title: Exclusive: Cognizant CEO reveals Anthropic AI partnership
content.description: In an exclusive interview with Ramzan Karmali, Ravi Kumar S, CEO of Cognizant, reveals a new partnership with AI firm, Anthropic. The professional services company will roll out Anthropic's Claude AI models to its 350,000 employees. He expects the deal will mean that his business will be able to provide better services to customers that will be driven by AI. For more live coverage of the markets, watch the full episode of Market Sunrise and visit Yahoo Finance.
